01 · The list

Every word,
in exam order

HSK 2 adds 147 new words on top of HSK 1, which brings the running total to about 300. These are the words of simple daily exchanges: shopping, directions, the weather, plans for the weekend. Every entry shows the hanzi, pinyin with tone marks and an English meaning.

In Lock&Learn Chinese this list is the HSK 2 pack: a word waits in hanzi with its pinyin; one tap reveals the meaning and a real sentence. HSK 2 opens with a free preview and another word unlocks daily; Lock&Learn+ opens every pack at once.

Type to filter by hanzi, pinyin or meaning. Flashcards hides the meaning until you tap a row; Shuffle deals the list in a new order.

02 · Sample sentences

25 words,
each in a sentence

Every word in Lock&Learn Chinese comes with a real example sentence, its reading and a translation, revealed on the tap. Here are 25 from this list.

从

cóng

from or through

他每天从学校走路回家。

Tā měitiān cóng xuéxiào zǒulù huíjiā.

He walks home from school every day.

告诉

gàosu

to tell or inform

请告诉老师你的名字。

Qǐng gàosu lǎoshī nǐ de míngzi.

Please tell the teacher your name.

公斤

gōngjīn

kilogram

这些苹果一共五公斤。

Zhèxiē píngguǒ yīgòng wǔ gōngjīn.

These apples weigh five kilograms in total.

公司

gōngsī

company or firm

他在那家公司工作。

Tā zài nà jiā gōngsī gōngzuò.

He works at that company.

贵

guì

expensive

这件衣服太贵了。

Zhè jiàn yīfu tài guì le.

This piece of clothing is too expensive.

还

hái

still or yet

他还在学校学习汉语。

Tā hái zài xuéxiào xuéxí Hànyǔ.

He is still studying Chinese at school.

红

hóng

red color

我喜欢那件红衣服。

Wǒ xǐhuān nà jiàn hóng yīfu.

I like that red piece of clothing.

回答

huídá

to answer

请回答我的问题。

Qǐng huídá wǒ de wèntí.

Please answer my question.

姐姐

jiějie

older sister

我有一个漂亮的姐姐。

Wǒ yǒu yī gè piàoliang de jiějie.

I have a beautiful older sister.

考试

kǎoshì

to take an exam

明天我们要考试。

Míngtiān wǒmen yào kǎoshì.

We are going to take an exam tomorrow.

快

kuài

fast or quick

请快一点，我们要迟到了。

Qǐng kuài yì diǎn, wǒmen yào chídào le.

Please hurry a bit, we are going to be late.

累

lèi

tired or weary

我今天工作太累了。

Wǒ jīntiān gōngzuò tài lèi le.

I am too tired from work today.

离

lí

away from

我家离学校很近。

Wǒ jiā lí xuéxiào hěn jìn.

My home is close to the school.

所以

suǒyǐ

therefore or so

因为下雨了，所以我没去学校。

Yīnwèi xiàyǔ le, suǒyǐ wǒ méi qù xuéxiào.

It was raining, so I did not go to school.

题

tí

exam question

这道题我不会做。

Zhè dào tí wǒ bù huì zuò.

I don't know how to do this question.

西瓜

xīguā

watermelon

我最喜欢吃的水果是西瓜。

Wǒ zuì xǐhuān chī de shuǐguǒ shì xīguā.

My favorite fruit to eat is watermelon.

笑

xiào

to laugh or smile

大家听了都笑了。

Dàjiā tīng le dōu xiào le.

Everyone laughed after hearing it.

姓

xìng

surname or be surnamed

请问您贵姓？

Qǐngwèn nín guìxìng?

May I ask what your surname is?

羊肉

yángròu

mutton

我中午喜欢吃羊肉。

Wǒ zhōngwǔ xǐhuān chī yángròu.

I like to eat mutton for lunch.

意思

yìsi

meaning or interest

Zhè běn shū hěn yǒu yìsi.

右边

yòubian

the right side

我的手机在桌子右边。

Wǒ de shǒujī zài zhuōzi yòubian.

鱼

yú

fish

Wǒ zài shāngdiàn mǎile sān tiáo yú.

I bought three fish at the store.

张

zhāng

Wǒ mǎi le yī zhāng bàozhǐ.

I bought a newspaper.

真

zhēn

really or truly

今天的天气真的很好。

04 · Questions

Asked and
answered

How many words are in the HSK 2 vocabulary list?

147. The six-level HSK syllabus adds about 150, 150, 300, 600, 1,300 and 2,500 new words per level, about 5,000 in all; this page lists the words that are new at HSK 2, not the cumulative total.

Is this the official HSK HSK 2 word list?

It follows the official six-level HSK syllabus (HSK 2.0), the list the HSK 1 to 6 exams are still administered on. The HSK 3.0 standard published in 2021 reorganises vocabulary into nine bands and is not what this page shows.

How do I study the HSK 2 list on my iPhone Lock Screen?

Install Lock&Learn Chinese, then touch and hold your Lock Screen, tap Customize, tap the widget area and choose Lock&Learn Chinese. The HSK 2 pack puts these words on the widget one at a time: you recall the meaning, one tap reveals it with a real sentence. HSK 2 opens with a free preview and another word unlocks daily; Lock&Learn+ opens every pack at once.

Can I download the HSK 2 vocabulary list as a PDF?

Yes. Use your browser's Print or Save as PDF: the page has a print layout that keeps only the heading and the full table, every word on this list.

Is Lock&Learn Chinese free?

Yes. The app is free on iOS: HSK 1 is free, every other pack opens with a free preview, and another word unlocks daily. Lock&Learn+ is an optional upgrade that opens every pack at once, offered as a yearly plan or a one-time lifetime purchase.
